context.focus: Canonical entity lifecycles, typed commands, reachable states, machine-readable guards, side effects, events, permissions, system requirements, SLAs, and executable exception paths.
forbidden_scope: deleting or replacing prior architecture artifacts
design work before workflow contracts pass
invented market demand, search volume, customers, reviews, rankings, backlinks, citations, or performance
mass-generated public pages or keyword permutations

definition_of_done: Every workflow references one or more SOPs and canonical entities.
Create, read, and update operations plus an explicit delete policy are defined.
Every transition names an actor, guard, event, and side effects.
Happy paths and exception paths are executable and auditable.
Every canonical entity has explicit create, read, update, archive, restore, and forbidden hard-delete policy.
Every user mutation and workflow transition resolves to a typed idempotent command with a permission and machine-readable guards.
Production identity and persistence prerequisites are explicit and fail closed.

After the owned section passes, append or update agent_evidence for workflow_architect_agent with status done, at least one scoped check in checks_passed, and an empty checks_failed list. Unfinished downstream stages are dependencies, not failures of this task.
